description: Manages DNS records by the Gandi LiveDNS API, see the docs: https://doc.livedns.gandi.net/.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Account API token. Note that these type of keys are deprecated and might stop working at some point. Use personal access tokens instead. One of personal_access_token and api_key must be specified.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The name of the Domain to work with (for example, example.com).

parameters.name: personal_access_token
parameters.description: Scoped API token. One of personal_access_token and api_key must be specified.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the record(s) should exist or not. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: The TTL to give the new record. Required when state=present.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of DNS record to create.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The record values. Required when state=present.

examples:
- name: Create a test A record to point to 127.0.0.1 in the my.com domain
  community.general.gandi_livedns:
    domain: my.com
    record: test
    type: A
    values:
      - 127.0.0.1
    ttl: 7200
    personal_access_token: dummytoken
  register: record

- name: Create a mail CNAME record to www.my.com domain
  community.general.gandi_livedns:
    domain: my.com
    type: CNAME
    record: mail
    values:
      - www
    ttl: 7200
    personal_access_token: dummytoken
    state: present

- name: Change its TTL
  community.general.gandi_livedns:
    domain: my.com
    type: CNAME
    record: mail
    values:
      - www
    ttl: 10800
    personal_access_token: dummytoken
    state: present

- name: Delete the record
  community.general.gandi_livedns:
    domain: my.com
    type: CNAME
    record: mail
    personal_access_token: dummytoken
    state: absent

- name: Use a (deprecated) API Key
  community.general.gandi_livedns:
    domain: my.com
    record: test
    type: A
    values:
      - 127.0.0.1
    ttl: 7200
    api_key: dummyapikey

return_values.name: record
return_values.description: A dictionary containing the record data. Returned: success, except on record deletion

return_values.name: domain
return_values.description: The domain associated with the record. Returned: success Sample: "my.com"

return_values.name: ttl
return_values.description: The time-to-live for the record. Returned: success Sample: 300

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The record type. Returned: success Sample: "A"

return_values.name: values
return_values.description: The record content (details depend on record type). Returned: success Sample: ["192.0.2.91", "192.0.2.92"]
